header.name: [bedrock-research]entity-matchmaking-bp_v2.0.0
header.description: v2.0.0 - A minigame matchmaking mockup drawn in an entity inventory screen: per game queues filled by simulated players, cancel, and a 10 second ready check, updated live from slot item names. Works next to the other entity inventory examples. Use the Matchmaking item from the creative inventory.
